methods.why: Subtract 2016 from 2023 live biomass, map differences and aggregate using a verified property boundary and consistent masks; assess vintage bias.

methods.name: Drone lidar and plot validation
methods.why: Calibrate lidar heights and structural metrics with geolocated field plots, compare 2026 biomass to 2023 and account for intervening growth and harvest.

methods.name: Annual disturbance mapping
methods.why: Identify disturbances between measurement dates to interpret biomass differences.

Quantify and report changes with uncertainty rather than treating 2026 lidar as direct validation of 2016–2023 change.
